description: This file is a shell script used for testing the behavior of Git submodule fetch operations, especially in recursive and on-demand scenarios. It defines a series of test cases verifying correct fetching, submodule updating, configuration overrides, and handling of edge cases related to submodules in a Git repository.

methods.name: write_expected_sub
methods.description: Creates expected output files for submodule fetch expectations with specific commits.

methods.name: write_expected_sub2
methods.description: Creates expected output files for secondary submodule fetch expectations.

methods.name: write_expected_deep
methods.description: Creates expected output files for deep nested submodule fetch expectations.

methods.name: write_expected_super
methods.description: Creates expected output files for superproject fetch expectations.

methods.name: add_submodule_commits
methods.description: Simulates new commits in submodules and generates expected fetch output.

methods.name: add_superproject_commits
methods.description: Commits updates to the superproject including submodule changes, preparing test expectations.

methods.name: verify_fetch_result
methods.description: Verifies the actual fetch error output against expected expectations.

methods.name: add_commit_push
methods.description: Helper to create commits and push in specified directories.

methods.name: compare_refs_in_dir
methods.description: Compares specific refs between two repositories or branches.

methods.name: fetch_with_recursion_abort
methods.description: Performs fetch with sed-based recursion detection to prevent infinite loops during fetch.
